intro: This repo describes the Greenstand cloud infrastructure: Terraform modules and Kubernetes manifests. There is no app to run. Do not run `terraform apply`, `kubectl apply`, or the deploy scripts: they change live Greenstand systems and need Greenstand credentials. The checks below run on your machine and need no credentials.
prerequisites: Terraform. CI installs the latest version with `hashicorp/setup-terraform`.
pre-commit (https://pre-commit.com/), or uv to run it with `uvx`.
kubectl, to render the Kubernetes manifests (optional).

steps.title: Install the Git hook
steps.text: The hook runs `terraform fmt` on your changed Terraform files before each commit. With uv, run `uvx pre-commit install` instead.

steps.title: Check the configuration
steps.text: CI runs the same `terraform fmt` check on each pull request. CI does not fail the pull request when the check fails (`continue-on-error: true`), so run the check before you push. With uv, run `uvx pre-commit run -a` instead.

steps.title: Render the Kubernetes manifests (optional)
steps.text: `kubectl kustomize` prints the manifests of one overlay and changes nothing. The pgpool, rabbitmq, and keycloak deployments each have a development, a test, and a production overlay.
